case.initial_message: So yesterday was a really long day. I woke up early, made coffee, and then spent almost an hour deciding what to wear because the weather in the city has been so unpredictable lately. I took the metro to work, had a long meeting about the quarterly planning, and then went to lunch with a colleague who told me all about her holiday plans, the restaurants she wants to try, and the new gym she joined near her apartment. In the afternoon there was more paperwork and a few phone calls with suppliers about delivery dates. On the way home, at the station, someone grabbed my phone out of my hand and ran away, it was an iPhone. After that I went home, cooked pasta, watched half a series, and thought about repainting the living room in a lighter colour because it feels dark. Anyway, I also need to remember to buy milk and call my aunt this weekend.
